args.message:
Fix rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and FIN-212
spec requiring banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), causing the nightly
build to fail in tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`, but the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Switch `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: passed (tests/test_money.py green).
